title: House of God
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child outlines Matthew 21:12-14: Jesus drives out those buying and selling in the temple, says it should be a house of prayer, and heals the blind and lame there; the church is a holy place to respect always.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the church is a place of prayer.
floor.question: What do people do in church?

steps: He drives out the traders and overturns tables.
He heals the blind and the lame.
contexts: a church compound on a weekday

board.do: Draw a temple with tables overturned.
Wait for the child to say the temple is a house of prayer.

misconceptions.ask: Whom did Jesus drive out of the temple?
What did Jesus say the temple should be?
When should we respect the church?
misconceptions.repair: List ways of respecting the church every day.

misconceptions.ask: Who came to Jesus at the temple after he drove out the traders (Matthew 21:14)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 21:14. Jesus cleared the temple for prayer and for healing.

checks.question: What did Jesus say the temple should be?
